verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents baselining, diff-aware scanning against a baseline, or marking findings as ignored or false positive so that only new issues alert. The 'Triage findings' material covers only sending alerts and creating tickets. Assistant's AI noise reduction is an adjacent feature, not suppression or baselining of existing findings.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert
